name: Shopping Tools
description: Tool contract for the Shopping App agent. Product search across Tesco, Sainsbury's, Amazon, and eBay; price comparison; basket management; and preference persistence.

tools.name: search_store
tools.description: Search a retailer for products matching the query. Returns a list with name, price, store, and URL.

tools.name: add_to_basket
tools.description: Add a product to the basket. Persists to /opt/shopping-app/data/basket.json.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare prices for a product across multiple retailers, sorted cheapest first.

tools.name: get_basket
tools.description: Get the current basket contents grouped by retailer with subtotals and a grand total.

tools.name: save_preference
tools.description: Persist a user preference. Keys: dietary, budget_max, preferred_store, brand, or any custom key.
